capability: Add a new kind of check, not a copy
title: Add a different gate.

hook.picture: Close: the whale stacks a second identical gate behind the first. A rust run passes both and a pod answers ✕.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We added more checks. The same bug still shipped.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: head of engineering, at the quarterly review

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: A long row of identical wobble gates. Three times, faster each time, rust runs sail through all of them and each pod answers ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Every check looks at the same thing.

stakes.body: Each extra copy of the same check costs time and money and catches nothing new, while customers keep hitting the same kind of bug.

solution_hint: Add a check that looks somewhere new.

metaphor.body: A row of identical gates all ask the same question, so the same bug passes them all. Swapping one copy for a gate with a new icon catches it.

steps.picture: The whale lifts the wobble icon off the middle gate and sets a colour lens there (a squash on placing it).
A rust run passes the first gate (glow), then stops at the lens gate. The bar drops.
steps.words: Swap one copy for a new kind.

steps.picture: Push-in: the last gate gets a gap icon. A run with a gap passes the other two and stops there.
A good run threads all three: three different glows.
The old identical copies, faded, stand to one side.
Runs keep flowing. Each kind of mistake stops at its own gate.
steps.words: More kinds catch more than more copies.

real_case.claim: A textbook landing page passed Manu's CSS-text detectors with 0 findings. Rendered-box detectors, a different kind of check, found 3 P0s.

honest_limit.picture: A clean run goes to the wrong pod, a question no gate asks. All three gates glow and the wrong pod answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: A question nobody asked still slips through.

not_this.body: All green means nothing known broke. Not good.

ending_pattern.body: The stacked identical gates from FELT peel apart into three gates of three kinds, and the same bug that passed them now stops.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close framing as bar 3: the stack that let the rust run through now stops it.

end_belief.body: Don't add copies. Add a new kind.
